messages:
zara: FYI Skyport wants a marketplace listing + joint launch. they asked for a compact launch kit: benchmark blog, 30m webinar, and a "how-to-list" doc. can we commit?

leo: Product needs to confirm GA connector artifacts. quick check: feature-flag ok?

mina: Ian take the benchmark narrative and landing copy. will aim for a clear headline + 2 charts (latency, $/1k). need perf numbers by Thu.

oscar: Eng: can run 48h perf sweep on 256/512 tokens. ETA 3 business days. will publish results CSV to s3://redwood-partners/skyport/bench/2965432100/

june: Webinar ops: partner prefers Tue mornings PT. propose 30m slot: 15m prerecord demo + 10m live Q&A + 5m CTA. registration page live 7 days before.

ops-bot: Reminder: do NOT include customer logs or PII. consent checkbox required. see https://confluence/redwood/privacy-guidelines

zara: Leads routing: Skyport will route marketplace leads to their CRM. we mirror leads into SFDC with minimal fields + consent flag and campaign tag. security: ephemeral token rotate every 30d.

leo: Proposed SFDC mapping: LastName, Company, Email, LeadSource = "Marketplace: Skyport", CampaignId=SP-2965, UTM params, Consent__c. require consent=true for exports.

mina: Draft contents: TL;DR, methodology appendix, perf chart, cost table, marketplace how-to (3 steps), CTA to sign up for partner onboarding.

oscar: sample webhook payload for partner:
POST /hooks/skyport HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.skyport.io
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>
{
  "name": "Jordan Park",
  "company": "NimbusCo",
  "email": "jordan@NimbusCo.com",
  "utm_campaign": "sp-launch-2965",
  "consent": true
}

zara: Action items:
- mina: blog + landing draft (due 5 business)
- oscar: perf run + logs + sample csv (due 3 business)
- leo: SFDC mapping + webhook spec (due 2 business)
- june: webinar page + emails + recording plan (due 7 business)

zara: Final sync Fri 9am PT to review assets and routing. drop blockers before EOD. :rocket:
